BiblicalUsage: Achad occurs once in the whole Bible, in the song of the sword: "Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set." The sword is commanded to converge, to make one choice and strike. A word used once, for a blade that will not be turned aside.
TheologicalSignificance: One occurrence of a rare verb proves nothing on its own, and the force of the verse lies in God's settled judgment, not in the word for converging.
